lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Why must students avoid inventing a local massacre story or sacred site name?

FEEDBACK
Those details belong to Custodians and verified histories; inventing them is disrespectful and may be false.

WATCH FOR
Saying settlement “didn’t affect anyone much” ignores well-documented harm and dispossession.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Complete an effects web from two published sources: land, food, water, culture, health. Tag any local claim as “needs Community verification”. Write one respectful action students can take (listen to First Nations voices).

Write a short reflection naming one source or idea you corrected and why.
